notes: Focused public C++ TCK contract for IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.5 p. 356 l. 389-129 and l. 395-131. The TCK constructs the official HLAnoCredentials class and calls the public RTIambassador Connect overload with it; the current-package custom Authorizer authorizes only when the RTI passes type HLAnoCredentials with an empty data value. This verifies class availability and the RTI-to-Authorizer handoff for that exact predefined credential on this provider path; it does not establish every Authorizer implementation or full §12.5 conformance.
